status: complete private-frame decoder source submilestone; M4.2-M4.6 incomplete
scope: Complete actual decode_frame body: entry/allocation, memcmp boundary, all short-circuit checks and internal readers, both zero loops, construction/structure copy, every switch branch and actual local free.
input: Arbitrary 160 initialized readable bytes, aligned writable 144-byte output, actual magic/run/UID/preflight globals, and separation needed to preserve input and post-copy globals. No acceptance, comparison outcome or execution certificate assumed.
result: Exact return from the actual source acceptance predicate; header rejection preserves all old memory, later rejection retains the constructed result. Every finite live prefix has ordinary enabled progress or an exact return; old memory outside the output is preserved through loss; every return actually frees the fresh local.
nonvacuity: Actual allocations at source magic/run/UID/preflight symbols and separate arbitrary input/output; all seven accepted tags and early/late rejection execute the whole source. Ordinary finite return runs for every owned input and arbitrary comparison waits followed by loss.
observation_boundary: Private parser only; distinct from Lean public parser. Arbitrary comparison waits, signed comparison magnitudes and asynchronous loss retained. Structure padding is arbitrary memory values; one Clight copy step is not compiled atomicity. No termination, whole-program initialization, Linux or hardware claim.
